objective: Make sensitive operation password precedence a single crate-private HTTP application policy shared by auth and taxonomy without changing public contracts or persistence.

precedence: non-empty BILL_ANALYSER_OPERATION_PASSWORD as authoritative configured fallback
missing, blank, or unsupported stored shapes fail closed
unchanged_boundaries: auth step-up JWT, TOTP, recovery, rate-limit, and audit orchestration
taxonomy user loading, account mutation, response mapping, and best-effort audit
settings bundle sensitive export remains current-password-only
REST, schema, session, configuration key, transaction, writer, and cents contracts
deleted_duplicate_contracts: auth-local bcrypt, environment, and stored password matcher
taxonomy-local bcrypt, environment, and stored password matcher
OperationPasswordPolicy::AllowUnset and OperationPasswordPolicy::RequireConfigured, whose behavior was identical
rejected_expansion: UnitOfWork, transaction owner, cache, or second writer
step-up, TOTP, audit, account mutation, or settings-export ownership

assertions: wrong current password with no fallback fails closed in auth and taxonomy
legacy stored password authorizes both account mutation and auth step-up
configured environment password shadows stored fallback
correct current password remains highest priority

cargo_test_workspace.result: passed against the live test container with BILL_ANALYSER_OPERATION_PASSWORD configured

cargo_llvm_cov_workspace.result: passed with CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 against isolated PostgreSQL databases

review.security_axis: passed: password-bearing functions retain skip_all tracing, auth and user scope precede sensitive operations, rate limits and audit ordering are unchanged, no SQL or public error detail was added, and settings export did not inherit operation-password fallback
review.residual_risk: Stored legacy operation passwords still use the pre-existing plaintext comparison contract; this slice centralizes but does not expand or migrate that compatibility surface.

verification.delivery_evidence: The Gitea PR and exact-head Actions record are authoritative external delivery evidence so recording their run identifiers cannot mutate the head they verify.

The first cargo test --workspace compile failed with Windows os error 1455 because the page file could not mmap parallel rustc metadata; the unchanged gate passed with -j 2.
Coverage used CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 for the same bounded-resource reason; no source or test contract was relaxed.

environment_hygiene.long_lived_development_database: not migrated, cleared, or used by the passing contracts
